Sample $Z_1, Z_2, ..., Z_d$ i.i.d. from $Lap((2(1)/(\varepsilon)))$. $Lap(t)$ stands for the Laplace distribution with scale parameter $t$ and location parameter $0$. The neighbouring datasets $D \in [0, 1]^{n \times d}$ and $D' \in [0, 1]^{n \times d}$ differ at most one row. Return $\tilde{f} = \argmax_{j \in \{1,2,...,d\}} (f(D_{*,j}) + Z_j)$. $D_{*,j}$ denotes the $j$-th column of matrix $D$. Does $\tilde{f}$ satisfies $\varepsilon$-differential privacy?
